rows.text: stores dword 0 at `0209E638 + ecx * 0x10` (`ecx` sign-extended), that is, at `+0x00` of the `0x10`-byte record `ecx` of the table at `0209E638`

when bit `0x2` of byte `+0xD3C` of the object at qword `0209AC30` is set, calls `00249180(rcx, 7, byte +0xB2D of that object + 0x10, 2)` with `rcx` passed through unchanged and 1 and 0 as the fifth and sixth (stack) arguments, and stores the returned qword at `+0x3C0` of the object at qword `0209AC30` (re-read); when the bit is clear it returns without the call or the store

when `ecx` < 5 (signed compare), stores the floats `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3` at `+0x40`, `+0x44` and `+0x48` of the `0x50`-byte record `ecx` (sign-extended) of the table at `02EBF420`; when `ecx` >= 5 it returns without a store

compares bit 0 of byte `02B40518` with the whole of `ecx`; when they are equal it returns without a store, otherwise it replaces bit 0 of that byte with bit 0 of `cl` (other bits kept), stores the byte back to `02B40518` and tail-jumps to `003B4FD0`
